interpretation: Frozen scaffold preservation is a stable attachment and connected-solid safeguard on all three pilot links.
It does not change relevant JR3, GCFR, or the identities of failed development configurations in this matrix.
It improves final-link voxel IoU and silhouette IoU on all three links, so this development result does not show a simple geometry-versus-attachment trade-off.
It increases Exact intersection volume for L04 and L07 and adds two collision events for L07, indicating a local collision-cost trade-off despite unchanged GCFR.
At the current evidence level the scaffold is best described as an engineering safeguard; a broader method-contribution claim requires unaccessed holdout and transfer evidence.
not_supported: The formal 32-case holdout performance is unknown.
The result does not establish generalization beyond three Robot-A pilot links.
The result does not establish absolute body reconstruction accuracy because body-only candidates are scored against full-link GT.
The result does not support a protected-cut or auto-attachment-closure contribution.
The result does not prove scaffold preservation universally improves collision metrics.
